## Description

A filamentous green alga of ~70 × 22 µm cells with a reticulate parietal chloroplast. When a cell
divides, its wall breaks in a ring and leaves stacked "caps" at one end (the divisions can be
counted). It also reproduces by zoospores: the whole protoplast leaves as a large cell with a crown of
flagella, swims ~1 h, settles and forms a new filament.
